name: Minimal Two-Step Workflow
description: Smallest valid workflow: start -> researcher -> writer -> output.

start.prompt: Write a 200-word summary of recent breakthroughs in quantum error correction.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Gathers facts and citations on the requested topic.
agents.instructions: You are a research agent. Given a topic, return a bulleted list of verifiable facts with sources. Do not speculate.

agents.name: Writer
agents.description: Turns the research bullets into a polished prose summary.
agents.instructions: You are a writer. You receive a bulleted research brief and return a polished prose summary of the requested length. Preserve every fact; do not add new ones.
